structure.unit: Fisheries and Habitat of the Tidal Waters
Use of Purse Nets for Taking Menhaden

law.catch_line: Carrying patent tongs, etc., while fishing for menhaden; penalty
law.text: It shall be unlawful for any captain or owner to carry or permit to be carried aboard his vessel, when fishing for menhaden, any scrape, dredge, or patent tongs. A violation of this section is a Class 1 misdemeanor.
